question: What native spatial support and nominal tissue-time denominators does the unchanged default MATLAB path produce in the eight published C02 inputs?
scope: BOI both signs; current automatic support audit only. No detector, event outcome, biological contrast, mask adoption, frame exclusion or approved window.

method.source: Unchanged loadOxygenStacks; all source frames, no denoised TIFF expected; exact external 1 Hz.
method.detrending: Unchanged detrend_custom(IM_Raw,3); original single input and double container output. Four MATLAB thread workers, one source at a time.
method.support: Unchanged computeRecordingArea with createOxygenMasterParams defaults: occupancy above each detrended frame mean, strict greater-than 30th percentile. No eligibleMask override.
method.signs: Surge native automatic mask. Sink same native mask with default 20-pixel border removed. Export masks, counts and nominal area-time.
method.diagnostics: Temporal above-mean count map, percentile ties, 8-connected mask components and included border fraction. No anatomical acceptance thresholds.
method.preview: First, ceil(N/2), last unchanged source frames; display limits retained from five-fixed-frame observability pass. Show occupancy map, binary mask and middle-frame excluded-area overlay.
method.exposure: Full [0,N) second nominal extents only. State established before recording, interval unmeasured; no inferred induction or signal-stability window.

success: Source/implementation hashes unchanged; independent count-to-mask, border, area and nominal area-time replay; visual review of eight maps. Current automatic support remains unvalidated anatomically.
stopping_rule: One unchanged-default pass; retain any failed attempt; no percentile sweep, outcome-driven mask or automatic follow-on detector.
